title: Trump’s Election Meddling Lies Mostly in Ruins
gist: David Ignatius argues Trump's year-long campaign to rewrite 2026 midterm rules has failed in nearly every phase thanks to court challenges and mobilized lawyers, though residual risks remain around ICE or troop deployment, Justice Department demands, and a late DNI foreign-meddling announcement.

insights.claim: The Supreme Court in September halted Trump's plan to give the US Postal Service authority over mail-in ballot envelopes, saying he was unlikely to succeed on the merits.
insights.speaker: David Ignatius
insights.so_what: Mail-ballot rules for the midterms are largely unchanged, reducing a key disruption risk.
insights.locator: Take Trump's repeated attempts to restrict mail-in voting

insights.claim: Most measures in Trump's March executive order have stalled or been blocked, and his Save America Act died for lack of support.
insights.speaker: David Ignatius
insights.so_what: Federal legislative route to rewriting election rules is closed before the midterms.

insights.claim: Trump's noncitizen-voting claim lacks a factual base: a study of 200 million federal votes found 15 indictments, and in Nevada DHS's claim of 15,903 registered noncitizens shrank to 185 on review, all of whom Nevada said were citizens.
insights.speaker: David Ignatius
insights.so_what: Fraud narratives are repeatedly refuted by data, weakening legal pretexts.

insights.claim: Courts have rejected voter-roll demands, a Riverside County sheriff's seizure of 650,000 ballots, and a subpoena for 2020 Fulton County poll worker names, while Wyoming's Republican governor rebuffed federal monitors.
insights.speaker: David Ignatius
insights.so_what: Pattern of judicial and state pushback, including from Republican officials.

insights.claim: Democracy Defenders Fund runs a $20 million Project 126 effort with WilmerHale and a dozen law firms, aiming to double the 63 legal victories that blocked Trump's 2020 overturn push.
insights.speaker: David Ignatius
insights.so_what: Rapid-response litigation capacity makes late-stage interference harder.
insights.quote: We know the playbook of Trump and the election deniers.
insights.locator: Eisen shared a list of 10 midterm election threats

insights.claim: Eisen's group has mobilized lawyers against ten threats including voter-roll purges, mail-in rules, federal agents at polls, seizure of ballots or machines, and intimidation of election officials.
insights.speaker: David Ignatius
insights.so_what: Checklist of interference vectors to monitor into Election Day.
insights.locator: Eisen shared a list of 10 midterm election threats

insights.claim: Democrats' biggest remaining fear is chaos on Election Day from ICE or troops, though Joint Chiefs chairman Gen. Dan Caine wrote in August that he had no plans to send military personnel or federalized Guard to polling places, and a suit seeks an injunction against intimidating ICE deployments.
insights.speaker: David Ignatius
insights.so_what: Election Day deployment is the main tail risk; a pending D.C. court ruling may come soon.

insights.claim: The Gabbard-led investigation of ballots and machines has died quietly since her departure, but a congressional official cautioned the DNI office could still announce foreign meddling late.
insights.speaker: David Ignatius
insights.so_what: A late foreign-interference announcement could be a source of electoral uncertainty.

insights.claim: Ignatius concludes the best protection is an anti-Trump turnout so large that Trump cannot challenge it, as analysts predict an angry wave of voters will swamp the GOP.
insights.speaker: David Ignatius
insights.so_what: Author's expectation of a strong Democratic midterm result.
